newsitems.title: Server maintenance is completed
newsitems.author: Morty
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ba448a63ac444d99bf54737a875daf1fc349d7e9.png"][/img][/p][p]The embodiment of Sin is coming! Raise your weapon and suffer… Before its shadows creep into your soul.[/p][p]While there’s still time, leave your offering and receive a gift in return:[/p][p][c]SZ-FESTIVITY-2026[/c][/p][p][i]The promo code can only be redeemed once per account. Valid until[b] December 1, 2026, at 20:59 (UTC).[/b][/i][/p][p]Let the Festivity begin![/p]

newsitems.title: Patch Notes [28.10.2026]
newsitems.author: oh_yeah
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/1fcaba130feaaede2266ee774d65aae455b18708.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Festivity[/b][/h1][p]Festivity is a PvPvE event in which a team of five players must defend their Relic from waves of mutants and zombies, fight bosses, and face off against another team. Everyone starts the match with no gear and levels up as they go, buying and upgrading equipment along the way.[/p][quote][p]The event is available to players who have reached Bar reputation level 2.[/p][/quote][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/eaadc1a6be8a65f43b207dda85c9ad4f82e392ca.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]How to play?[/b][/h2][p]The team's main objective is to defend the Relic, which stands in the center of the PvE Arena.[/p][p]A match is divided into rounds that play out in the following order:[/p][list][*][p]3 PvE rounds, in which you fight waves of mutants and zombies. The maximum damage your Relic can take during one round is 15%.[/p][/*][*][p]A boss round. Every boss has unique abilities, so stay alert![/p][/*][*][p]A PvP round, in which you face the opposing team. The team that deals more damage to the Altar, the structure in the center of the map, wins. The losing side's Relic takes 10% damage.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/7275a238ba39bc96efd96dff6ddcb81490594e10.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][quote][p]An important feature of the PvP arena is bioinfection on the lower floor of the location. Only players in Scientist armor can stay in areas with level 4 bioinfection. Players in Combo armor can only stay in areas with level 2 and 3 bioinfection. Everyone else will have to attack the Altar from the upper position.[/p][/quote][p]The maximum number of rounds in a match is [b]25[/b].[/p][p]From round 6 onward, modifiers are active in the match. They change every round and make your life harder.
From round 11 onward, two modifiers are active at the same time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/384a74045d1deca42d254847b20e4a48f9c7728e.png"][/img]The match ends if:[/p][list][*][p]One team's Relic is completely destroyed;[/p][/*][*][p]The players reach round 25. In that case, the team whose Relic has more durability remaining wins;[/p][/*][*][p]One of the teams surrenders. Surrender button becomes available after round 15. Activating it starts a vote. If all team members agree, the team is defeated.
The button can be found in the bottom left corner when you open the match statistics with ~ key.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Shop and gear[/b][/h2][p]All players start the match with a knife, a pistol, and 100 coins. This currency is called Yav. It's used in the shop to buy armor, weapons, and Amulets, as well as to upgrade and refresh the shop.[/p][quote][p]Yav is earned by completing rounds. The amount you receive depends on several factors:[/p][/quote][list][*][p]In a regular PvE round: how much Relic durability was lost;[/p][/*][*][p]In a boss round and in a PvP round: whether you win or lose;[/p][/*][*][p]How many coins you have from the previous round. 

The more Yav you have before the next round starts, the more bonus coins you'll get. For every 10 coins in hand at the end of a round, you receive +1 coin, up to a maximum of 30 coins.
You can see the bonus coin details by hovering over the Yav icon in your inventory.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9ce83486428a9514884aaf8f2e0f3d1c3cf70277.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]Before each round, you get time to prepare and shop. The shop is built into your inventory. You can open it with the E key.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/12b09c8d4733dae143305cb9d66a9084ebae240a.png"][/img][/p][p]Several armor and weapon branches are available. Each armor type has its own characteristics:[/p][list][*][p]Combat armor is great for holding back enemy attacks, but prevents you from going down to the lower level of the PvP arena. It uses fragmentation grenades.[/p][/*][*][p]Combo armor can withstand level 2 and 3 bioinfection (at higher armor ranks) in parts of the lower level of the PvP arena. It uses healing grenades.[/p][/*][*][p]Scientist armor allows you to go down to the Altar and survive level 4 bioinfection. It also uses a shield grenade that blocks bullets.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Gear upgrade[/b][/h3][p]To assemble higher rank gear, you need to purchase three of its blueprints.[/p][p]Blueprints matching your current gear are highlighted in the shop.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f6eac306f56586ffa0c8e1f2067ccbcd231834bc.png"][/img]All items in the shop are limited in quantity and are drawn from a shared pool. If you purchase one of the blueprints, it disappears from the shared pool, even if you sell it later.[/p][p]Gear blueprints can also be used to upgrade armor or weapons to +5 and +10. To do this, purchase the required blueprint, then press Shift + LMB or drag it from your inventory into the equipment window.[/p][p]After purchasing the third blueprint, the gear will automatically upgrade to the next rank.[/p][quote][p]Keep in mind that gear can only be upgraded in the correct order — from Picklock or Newbie to Master. You cannot upgrade Newbie armor or weapons straight to Master rank, skipping the Stalker and Veteran ranks![/p][/quote][list][*][p]The maximum available rank for armor and primary weapons is Master.[/p][/*][*][p]The maximum available rank for secondary weapons is Legendary.[/p][/*][/list][p]If there is no items you need in the shop, you can refresh it for 10 Yav.[/p][p]If the item you need appears in the shop but you can’t afford it yet, lock the shop by clicking the lock icon in the upper-right corner. In this case, the current set of items will be saved and carried over to the next round.[/p][h3][b]Shop upgrade[/b][/h3][p]Yav can be spent not only on gear, but also on increasing the shop’s level. The higher its level, the higher the chance of finding higher-rank gear blueprints and the more Amulets you can equip.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c8208a2cf1d6468880b4b57c11bf4aaf6d668935.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/890062afef04ea2a1a1e3474ccf0bbb3fa24b40a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Amulets[/b][/h3][p]Amulets — are artifacts with special stats that can be purchased in the shop.[/p][p]Each Amulets belongs to one of the following sets: Skitter, Fiend, Ghoul, Rat, or Multiset.[/p][p]A set consists of three different artifacts and provides additional bonuses.[/p][p]You can learn more about each set’s effects in the dedicated inventory tabs.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/6243f04c6535e9f1c7af1cc1555a546a0d1fdc61.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/31139d19ead854973672dc4a41ffb45d236756f2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/cd689d5e3f1e1b0f348c1ed2580440fc62ba6793.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/720046a6420b45290d5158ace74221f88d1f8601.png"][/img][/p][quote][p][b]Note![/b] A set only works with [b]different[/b] artifacts from the same collection. If you buy two completely [b]identical[/b] Amulets, the set's additional effect will not activate.[/p][/quote][p]Multiset is a special Eti Amulet, that can work with any other set.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/882d46bbfeee0fa7ddf24d69b80d727b4a9d5b8f.png"][/img][/p][p]Amulets can be upgraded up to [b]+15[/b]. To do this, find and buy another identical Amulet and combine it with the first one.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/05991f2810ad1a7c9558d263ef6a111a7ba5692b.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Rewards[/b][/h2][p]At the end of a match, you'll receive rubles and Chrismites, the event currency.[/p][p]Chrismites can be spent in the event shop on various rewards, including: [/p][list][*][p]5.45 Extended Magazine;[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/5aab02cf296e1f77a3d36d609dba0ff78c6dd171.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Athame hunter's knife;[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f98ab947c10d06c37b7a881406208d460520722f.png"][/img][/p][previewyoutube="BMAaGJ5Oab4;full"][/previewyoutube][list][*][p]Myron, Death Knell, Crimson styles;[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2a92267d5b2eabdb915c24b5316493ea45d24e01.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Hideout decorations;[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/77efeb0e502aaa671fe12a97a162b129f479d9c0.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Implements event case;[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/966350e30a2572ff280e331fb3b543443dc296d8.png"][/img][/p][quote][p] Magazine, knife, decor and styles can be sold to Zen for event currency.[/p][/quote][list][*][p]Various consumables.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/398b314303a97e83093800aaff904c29fb83022f.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Progression[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/8b481260ff6bf9210a6ac23271c52c5b7ed1f759.png"][/img][/p][p]Access to the progression mode will open on [b]November 4[/b] after maintenance, and it will remain active until the end of the event on November 18. [/p][p]Progression mode will be available from 10:00 [b](server time)[/b] to 00:00 [b](server time)[/b].[/p][p]Progression consists of leagues. Up to the Epiphany league, you'll earn points for both wins and losses, but fewer for a loss.[/p][p]Rewards can be claimed immediately after you move from one league to the next. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/03b7e688710e0f0293840847b8810aea1a63f668.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/c1c6994f97d7f907e2cf89a0d7d5e7cf36dbb079.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/66525e12a800234bb48b9e50286621df2a315d03.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9d887572f7ed388f3d3ab300ecdd928864c55b0e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/74be5fb16b37e9a9be96a379c16cede4fd1c30ec.png"][/img][/carousel][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img]In addition to rewards for reaching new leagues, you’ll also receive extra Chrismites for reaching certain milestones.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9c28bcbbe8ca6f894a40e08117babd7244942fef.png"][/img][/p][p]In the Epiphany and Deliverance leagues, points are deducted for a loss. Rewards for reaching these leagues are only issued [b]after the event ends[/b].[/p][p]Only 10% of players who reach league 5 will enter the Epiphany league, while the Deliverance league will include limited number of players with the highest number of points:[/p][list][*][p]EU — 90,[/p][/*][*][p]NA — 15,[/p][/*][*][p]SEA — 10,[/p][/*][*][p]NEA — 10.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/243dec6cc2fc35ea3bbe8402c37be110e0a647f5.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/555006d6cb8cd936288e3c0aaab01442afdb53a9.png"][/img][/p][p]A case containing personal styles from previous Arenas is one of the rewards in the Epiphany and Deliverance leagues.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/9ff6e1e23d99086b71dc3f4fe9b4a05cb1310aef.png"][/img][/p][quote][p]The reward in the case can be rerolled up to 8 times. Each reroll costs 5 million rubles. Duplicate items will not drop, so you are guaranteed to receive any style you want.[/p][/quote][h2][b]Tokens[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fc94f172997db0b0a56a625dab8f482347b70cb4.png"][/img][/p][p]Double progression tokens will let you climb the leagues faster. They can be purchased in the shop or obtained from Implements event case.[/p][p]However, use them wisely in the Epiphany and Deliverance leagues: alongside the potential reward, the risk of losing more points also increases![/p][p]You can use up to 3 tokens per match. Depending on how many you use, the following multiplier is applied to the points you earn:[/p][list][*][p]1 token: ×2;[/p][/*][*][p]2 tokens: ×2.6;[/p][/*][*][p]3 tokens: ×3[/p][/*][/list][quote][p]In the Festivity event, tokens will only be active during the event and will be converted into Trade coins once it ends. This will help maintain fair competition and balance in each mode.[/p][/quote][h2][b]Challenges[/b][/h2][p]Added Festivity challenges to the Season Pass.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/50bd6a84bc1b567a02244389750a16e2fd01612d.png"][/img]You can find even more challenges and rewards in the event's dedicated tab.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/702f8b66850188310b2f3c5e3ed8501c4f8d4f64.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Spend your weekends at Festivity![/b][/h2][p]From November 7, 05:00 (server time) to November 9, 05:00 (server time), and from November 14, 05:00 (server time) to November 16, 05:00 (server time), matches will earn [b]30% more rubles and Chrismites[/b].[/p][p]Don't miss the moment when the Zone is merciful and rewards suffering.[/p][h1][b]Safe Zones decorations[/b][/h1][p]Residents of safe zones have started putting their own spin on the usual deserted corners… Come take a look![/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/173ab8cd15751b57c0f641bb1fc3b81233d0d136.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/95133e75b88bfda0e3eb792693cbbb22825fea2f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/1e57a9b3d578c1d75700e1788adaa8a3431c4972.png"][/img][/carousel][h1][b]New season quests[/b][/h1][h3][b]tulpa! season quests[/b][/h3][p]This fall, the Zone faced a primal horror for the first time. Each faction follows its own path in the hope of defeating it: some seek salvation in science, while others seek it in rituals. [b]Fire and Ash[/b], [b]Save and Protect[/b], [b]Two Thousand Yards[/b], and [b]Deus Ex Machina [/b]quests explore just how far people are willing to go to avoid being left alone with their own fears.[/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p][b]Faction[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Quest name[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]How to get?[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Mercenaries[/p][/td][td][p]Two Thousand Yards[/p][/td][td][p]Talk with Wentz and Bitok[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Rise[/p][/td][td][p]Deus Ex Machina[/p][/td][td][p]Talk to Sitnikov[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Covenant[/p][/td][td][p]Save and Protect[/p][/td][td][p]Find the place at Temple Swamp[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Frontier[/p][/td][td][p]Fire and Ash[/p][/td][td][p]Find the place at Barrier[/p][/td][/tr][/table][h3][b]Shock wave part 2[/b][/h3][p]Lynx finally found where Cleat was hiding. This means that Liv's plan to pit the Black Market against Typhoon is still underway. Who will win this dangerous game?[/p][h1][b]Economic adjustments[/b][/h1][h2][b]Randomization of rewards for completing events[/b][/h2][p]We previously announced that we would be updating the randomization system for the final rewards earned from completing events.[/p][p]The current system is outdated and sometimes results in situations where you receive an unreasonably small reward for a complex event. After the update, you will always receive 100% of the base reward, and there’s a chance you’ll receive an increased reward.[/p][h2][b]Comparison of rewards[/b][/h2][p]It is important to note that this comparison shows the minimum rewards that can be earned using the different randomization systems (the old and the new).[/p][quote][p]If you look at the long-term farm, you'll notice that the income you earn, if it has increased at all, has only increased slightly.[/p][/quote][p]The main goal of the updated system is to address the issue of unfair rewards.[/p][p]For example, when:[/p][list][*][p]For a complex and large event, you were paid unreasonably little;[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]For an easy event, you received an unreasonably large amount.[/p][/*][/list][table equalcells="1" colwidth=",,"][tr][td][p align="center"][b]Event[/b][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Before[/b][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Now[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Event at Mines/Inflow[/p][p][/p][/td][td][p align="center"]~3899 rubles[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]~5130 rubles[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Event at Forge-11[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]~7642 rubles[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]~10 055 rubles[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Event at Stillwaters[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]~20 520 rubles[/p][/td][td][p align="center"]~27 000 rubles[/p][/td][/tr][/table][h3][b]Other adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Changed the sales limit for the Detector Components item at Arsen: 165 → 170.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Achievement Showcase[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/38ca219048e780e37af31d1348c441dd5fce26a6.png"][/img][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/915f734d146c283bea17612129357055dfce9602.png"][/img]The right-hand column in the profile is changed and is now called Achievement Showcase. All settings for pinned statistics and achievements are now located in the profile customization section, in a new tab between the profile card and music.[/p][p]Within Statistics and Achievements, the only features remaining are viewing and managing privacy settings for other players. The settings for the showcase itself are now flexible: you can customize each row individually and rearrange them in any order.[/p][p]Added the ability to pin items in the Achievements Showcase. A line can contain 2 statistics, 1 achievement, or 3 items. You cannot change the number of elements within a row (for example, changing the number of elements from 3 to 2 or 4). You can only pin personal items. Items from your inventory and personal storage are added to the list if you are in a safe zone.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0488fbe61cdadd53664fe0f70645fc8804de26cf.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Interface and controls[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Player interactions menu:[/b] the menu that appears now does not block controls or capture the mouse cursor. You can still move and shoot. To select an action, use the hotkeys indicated on the buttons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shop:[/b] when you left-click on an item in the Suitable for section on the style/motif page, the 3D model changes to show the selected item equipped with the style/motif. Minor issues with interactions involving item slots in sets are also fixed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Season Pass:[/b] a notification now appears when the level increases. Updated icons and tooltips for rewards.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Task log:[/b] added the ability to pin exchange recipes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]HUD:[/b] added highlighting for events required to complete active quests.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hideout:[/b] if another object is required to open an object, the tooltip now specifies which one.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weapon examination:[/b] now has its own button in the settings.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Map changes[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/f0021bb079d24d5d752eb0b2b77a246190bb0226.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The map now matches the current season's color palette.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor bugs in the map display.[/p][/*][*][p]Objects in the world are now displayed on the map as well.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Grace of Festivity[/b][/h2][p]The new bundle is now available in the in-game store! It includes event currency, cases, seasonal crates, season levels, and Overdrives.[/p][p]The first six purchases come with discounts of up to 75%. Now’s a good time to stock up![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/dd683e850d797d72a7d9c65ac751411536c89d2c.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Guide[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Added articles on safes, looting, in-game chat, Arsenal, trading with other players, and using attachments.[/p][/*][*][p]Added and translated articles on infections, base traders, subdivision battles, anomalies, and side effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Interaction and Communication section. It includes the following articles: In-Game Chat, Squad, Player Exchange, and Subdivision.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved article formatting for easier reading.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Balance adjustments[/b][/h1][table equalcells="1" colwidth="344,"][tr][td colwidth="344"][p align="center"][b]Item[/b][/p][/td][td][p align="center"][b]Changes[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colspan="2" colwidth="344,0"][p]Assault Rifles[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]FN Scar-H (A)[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 47 → 46.5[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]FN Scar-H[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 45.1 → 44.6[/p][p][i]The FN Scar-H is slightly weakened (by half of the last buff), as it became too effective after many recent adjustments.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]HK417 (A)[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 45.2 → 45.5[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]HK417[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 43.4 → 43.6[/p][p][i]The HK417 is slightly bto compete more fairly with other similar rifles.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]K2C1[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 39 → 39.3[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]K2[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 34 → 34.3[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]AK-15[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 47.5 → 47.8[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]AK-203[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 38.4 → 39[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]AUG A3 (A)[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 41.3 → 41.8[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]Steyr AUG A3[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 36.3 → 36.5[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]ASM Serval[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 37.5 → 37.1[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]AMB-17[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 42 → 41.8[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]X95 (A)[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 32.2 → 32.4[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]IWI Tavor X95[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 30.9 → 31[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]FN F2000 Tactical[/p][/td][td][p]
Minimum damage: 31.9 → 32.3[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]HK G36C[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 34.8 → 35.5[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]TKB-0146M[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 36.6 → 37.5[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]QBZ-191 Thunderbird[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 37.6 → 37.7[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]AK-12[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 37.5 → 38[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]AK-12 (A)[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 43 → 43.5[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]Comment[/p][/td][td][p][i]Less popular assault rifles and ones that lag behind their counterparts are now stronger, while overly effective assault rifles designed for close combat are now weaker.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colspan="2" colwidth="344,0"][p]Machine guns[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]DSA RPD[/p][/td][td][p]Damage: 39.3 → 39.8[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]M60[/p][/td][td][p]Damage: 51 → 51.2[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]PKP Pecheneg[/p][/td][td][p]Damage: 45.3 → 45.5[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]Worn PKP[/p][/td][td][p]Damage: 39.8 → 40[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]RPL-20[/p][/td][td][p]Damage: 44 → 44.5[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]Comment[/p][/td][td][p][i]Slightly buffed the machine guns that were less effective in terms of PvP.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colspan="2" colwidth="344,0"][p]Sniper rifles[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]OTL-03 Karbach[/p][/td][td][p]Headshot damage: 1.5 → 1.54[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]Cheytac M300[/p][/td][td][p]Headshot damage: 1.15 → 1.18[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]FN Scar SSR[/p][/td][td][p]Damage and minimum damage: 71.5 → 72[/p][p][i]It was lightly behind the MK14 in terms of PvP effectiveness.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colspan="2" colwidth="344,0"][p]Submachine guns[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]Scorpion EVO III[/p][/td][td][p]Damage: 30.6 → 30.5[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]TDI Kriss Vector[/p][/td][td][p]Damage: 34.8 → 34.6[/p][p]Minimum damage: 19.3 → 19.1[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]SR-3M[/p][/td][td][p]Damage: 33.1 → 32.8[/p][p]Recoil: 0.51° → 0.59°[/p][p]Maximum damage range: 16 → 15[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]SR-3 Vikhr[/p][/td][td][p]Damage: 29 → 28.9[/p][p]Recoil: 0.45° → 0.56°[/p][p]Maximum damage range: 16 → 15[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]SIG MPX[/p][/td][td][p]
Minimum damage: 21.3 → 21.5[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]
PPK-20[/p][p]Vityaz-SN[/p][p]PP-19-01 Vityaz[/p][/td][td][p]
Rate of fire: 750 → 760[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]Comment[/p][/td][td][p][i]Excessively powerful submachine guns are weakened, and less popular ones are slightly strengthened.
The SR-3M and Vector lead the pack in terms of the number of kills and, at the same time, boast a very high kill efficiency.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colspan="2" colwidth="344,0"][p]Pistols[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]Sig Sauer P320[/p][/td][td][p]
Damage: 75 → 74[/p][p][i]The SIG Sauer P320 stands out from other pistols because of its great versatility: its massive damage per magazine and high comfort make it the preferred choice in far too many situations.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]Magpul FMG-9[/p][/td][td][p]
Recoil: 0.3° → 0.25°[/p][p]Horizontal recoil: 0.26° → 0.25°[/p][p][i]Increased FMG-9's comfort, as its high recoil was reducing this pistol's effectiveness too much.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colspan="2" colwidth="344,0"][p]Shotguns[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]AEK-965[/p][/td][td][p]
The recoil after firing is slightly reduced.[/p][p][i]Now, almost immediately after firing a shot, the shooter experiences a minimal level of stopping power.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colspan="2" colwidth="344,0"][p]Attachments[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]ASh-12 Extended Magazine[/p][/td][td][p]
Reload: 3 sec → 3.25 sec[/p][p]Tactical Reload: 2.4 sec → 2.6 sec[/p][p]Added Recoil: -5%[/p][p]Added Horizontal recoil: -5%[/p][p]Added Recoil increase: -10%[/p][p][i]ASh-12 Extended Magazine was at a significant disadvantage in terms of ergonomics, since the weapon's base damage is high enough for it to perform perfectly well even with a 25-round magazine.
 However, since the weapon isn't particularly effective even with a high-capacity, ergonomic magazine, it won't be weakened. Instead, the underpowered magazine will be upgraded.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colspan="2" colwidth="344,0"][p]Armor[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]Aurora Jumpsuit[/p][/td][td][p]
Bullet resistance: 39 → 42[/p][p]Added Speed: 1%[/p][p]Carry weight: 5 kg → 7 kg[/p][p]Bleeding Protection: 35% → 25%[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]
Seekers Exoskeleton[/p][p]Morgues Exoskeleton[/p][/td][td][p]
Removed Stamina: -15%[/p][p]Bullet resistance: 158 → 151[/p][p]Now compatible with any containers[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="344"][p]Arc Jumpsuit[/p][/td][td][p]
Fixed incorrect sizes: small → medium[/p][/td][/tr][/table][h1][b]Other changes and fixes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Refined the quest chain at the start of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed sound design for Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant: added ambient sounds and new music.[/p][/*][*][p]Injectors are now unlocked as you progress through the tutorial and are available for purchase from merchants in all safe zones.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with sending private messages to players whose usernames contain a large number of consecutive underscores.[/p][/*][*][p]Added sound effects when upgrading armor and weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the position of the Bale bag on the back: it is now positioned slightly higher.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed kill tasks that required a specific weapon.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where a character could get stuck while climbing an obstacle, causing the character to slow down and damage to be incorrectly applied.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game crashes with AMD drivers newer than version 26.8.1.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that prevented penalties to be added to spread in jumps in some cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the appearance of items in the radial menu was not updated correctly when they were replaced or upgraded.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the model and animations of the RSh-12, as well as the textures of its motifs, and adjusted the visuals of cartridges in skins.[/p][/*][*][p]The faction bonus to the selling price now also applies to the Fence in the Drunken Geiger Bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Twins being absent from the Signal dungeon.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a game crash that occurred when opening the key holder during a trade with another player.[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Go higher in Festivity leagues
newsitems.author: Preim
newsitems.contents: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/842e40ce3685d4e398b0acfd185949942c4c563e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0a8ee35abac261de84bacf3434f6ca21d0c0b51a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/ff720e6a78844f6795dde450aa2d63e5218c3395.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Here’s how progression will work[/b][/p][p]The progression mode will unlock on [b]November 4[/b] and remain available until the event ends on [b]November 18[/b]. The mode will be available from [b]10:00 AM[/b] to [b]12:00 AM[/b] server time.[/p][quote][p]The first five leagues are fixed. You can earn points for both wins and losses in them. [/p][p]The two highest leagues are where the real competition begins! Losing a match will cost you points in these leagues.[/p][/quote][p]Double progression tokens will help you earn more points per match. You can purchase them in the shop or obtain them from event cases. But use them wisely: while they can boost your points, they also increase the risk of losing more.[/p][quote][p]We understand that some players have already encountered similar tokens in other modes. In Festivity, the tokens will only be usable within the event and will be converted into Trade Coins once it ends. This helps keep competition fair and allows us to balance each mode separately.[/p][/quote][p]Which league are you aiming for? Tell us in the comments.[/p]

newsitems.title: Festivity OTS
newsitems.author: Morty
newsitems.contents:
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/2d0d8c8489b8946afd94792532abd0c6821bd3e4.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]In this article, we’ll explain what OTS is, and how to test the Festivity event.[/p][h2][b]What is OTS?[/b][/h2][p align="start"]OTS stands for Open Test Server. Here, you gain access to early versions of updates.[/p][quote][p]This time, it is open for [b]EU[/b] and [b]RU[/b] players only.[/p][/quote][p align="start"]Your task is to provide feedback to help us identify and fix issues before the final release.[/p][quote][p]On the OTS, your character will have the gear they had at the moment they were added to the testing participant list.[/p][p]Progress is not transferred between servers, and everything you do with items on OTS stays there.[/p][/quote][h2][b]Participants list[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Access to the OTS will be granted to a [b]limited [/b]number of players who reached the Bar reputation level 2 and played more than 10 hours last month.[/p][h2][b]How do I know if I have access?[/b][/h2][p align="start"]EXBO launcher users will see a separate server available for download — STALZONE OTS.[/p][p align="start"]Steam players can check for an in-game message titled “[b]OTS invitation[/b]”, sent by System to their most recently active character. If you don’t have this message, you are not eligible for testing.[/p][h2][b]Testing period[/b][/h2][quote][p]OTS will run from October 23, 2026, 15:00 (UTC) to October 25, 2026, 20:59 (UTC).[/p][/quote][p align="start"][b]Please note![/b] This is a test server. It may be stopped or restarted for changes anytime.[/p][h2][b]What we're looking for on this OTS?[/b][/h2][p align="start"]We want to hear your thoughts on the mode’s gameplay, economy, and balance.[/p][p align="start"]All OTS testers will have access to a survey about Festivity event.[/p][quote][p]To participate in the survey, please open your in-game mail on the test server and select the "OTS survey" message.[/p][/quote][p align="start"]We are counting on your feedback. You can also discuss the event tests on our [url="https://discord.gg/stalzone"][u]Discord server[/u][/url] in the [url="https://discord.com/channels/996757051399221288/1563197785875157142"]discussion[/url].[/p][p align="start"][i]Please be understanding of any issues and not finished parts. We will monitor and maintain OTS until it ends.[/i][/p][h2][b]How to start playing on OTS?[/b][/h2][p align="start"]OTS will be available to players in [b]RU[/b] and [b]EU[/b] regions. Steam login remains supported.[/p][p align="start"]If you’re using the launcher and have access, the server will automatically appear in your download list.[/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/3f0fa75aac63018e31bbc46cfe1871683c0c4eac.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]To join via Steam, you need to choose the available beta version in the game settings.[/p][quote][p][b]Important note! In Steam, the beta version is available for download to everyone, even those who were not included on the participant list.[/b][/p][/quote][p align="start"]This could lead to a situation where you waste bandwidth downloading but are unable to participate in testing.[/p][p align="start"]To avoid this, we recommend using the EXBO Launcher to log into the test server, even if you usually play through Steam.
Detailed instructions are available [url="https://support.exbo.net/en/help-center/articles/68/71/171"][u]here[/u][/url].[/p][h2][b]What should you do on the OTS?[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Open the ESC menu, go to the [b]Festivity[/b] tab, and click [b]Play[/b] to start the match.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/0f6db89cad8be1b47a1b4511dc331a531407b75f.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]More about the event[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Festivity is a PvPvE event where a team of five players must defend their Relic — a structure located in the center of the arena.[/p][p align="start"]The match is divided into rounds:[/p][list][*][p]In the first three rounds, you’ll fight waves of mutants and NPCs;[/p][/*][*][p]In the fourth round, you’ll face a boss;[/p][/*][*][p]Every fifth round, you’ll face an opposing team. The team that deals more damage to the structure in the center of the map wins the round.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]All players start the match without any gear and with 100 coins to spend in the shop (press “E”). You’ll start with low-tier armor and weapons and can upgrade your gear as the match progresses.[/p][p align="start"]You’ll earn coins for completing rounds. The shop offers several armor and weapon options, as well as special Talismans with different stats.[/p][p align="start"]Talismans can be combined into sets that provide additional bonuses. To complete a Talisman set, you need to use [b]different[/b] Talismans from the same set rather than duplicates.[/p][p align="start"]Besides buying gear, you can also spend coins to refresh and upgrade the shop. The higher the shop level, the more Talismans you can place in your container and the higher the chance of finding higher-tier gear.[/p][p align="start"]You’ll learn more about the event while testing it. In your feedback, you can also let us know how clear or confusing you found the different game mechanics.[/p][h2][b]I found a bug, how can I report it?[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Any issues discovered during testing can be reported to our Support:[/p][p][url="https://support.exbo.games/en"]https://support.exbo.games/en[/url][/p][p align="start"]For your convenience, you can also refer to the guides:[/p][list][*][p][url="https://support.exbo.net/en/help-center/articles/94/97/184"][u]Creating and filing a ticket[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://support.exbo.net/en/help-center/articles/94/95/98/obnaruzen-nedocyot-v-igrovoi-mexanike"][u]Bug report of the game mechanics[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://support.exbo.net/en/help-center/articles/94/95/99/obnaruzen-nedocyot-na-karte"][u]Bug report of the game world map[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://support.exbo.net/en/help-center/articles/94/95/332"][u]Bug report of another kind of bug[/u][/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://support.exbo.net/en/help-center/articles/94/95/100/obnaruzen-nedocyot-v-zadanii"][u]Bug report of the game quest[/u][/url][/p][/*][/list][h2][b]OTS challenges and rewards[/b][/h2][p align="start"]To receive rewards, complete tasks in the Open Test Challenges tab of the Event Hub.[/p][quote][p]Rewards for successfully completed challenges will be sent to the main server and credited to the appropriate characters within 30 business days after OTS ends.[/p][/quote][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][th][p]Challenge[/p][/th][th][p]Reward[/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Deal 5 000 damage to the object in the center of the arena during a PvP round[/p][/td][td][p]• 2 Fishie Crates[/p][p]• 1 000 Season Pass points[/p][p]• 5 Unstable Anomalous Batteries[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Survive 70 PvE rounds without dying[/p][/td][td][p]• 3 Fishie Crates[/p][p]• 4 000 Season Pass points[/p][p]• 5 Overloads[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Win 10 PvP rounds[/p][/td][td][p]• 2 Fishie Crates[/p][p]• 2 000 Season Pass points[/p][p]• 5 Unstable Anomalous Batteries[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Survive 15 rounds without your Relic taking any damage[/p][/td][td][p]• 3 Fishie Crates[/p][p]• 4 000 Season Pass points[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Kill 500 mutants and zombies[/p][/td][td][p]• 2 Fishie Crates[/p][p]• 3 000 Season Pass points[/p][p]• 5 Unstable Anomalous Batteries[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Kill 20 bosses[/p][/td][td][p]• 3 Fishie Crates[/p][p]• 4 000 Season Pass points[/p][p]• 3 days of Premium[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Kill 50 players from the enemy team[/p][/td][td][p]• 2 Fishie Crates[/p][p]• 2 000 Season Pass points[/p][p]• 5 Unstable Anomalous Batteries[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Assemble 1 piece of master tier gear[/p][/td][td][p]• 1 Fishie Crate[/p][p]• 5 Overdrives[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Spend 2 000 coins in the mode[/p][/td][td][p]• 2 Fishie Crates[/p][p]• 5 Unstable Anomalous Batteries[/p][p]• 5 Overdrives[/p][/td][/tr][/table][h2][b]Conclusion[/b][/h2][p align="start"]We are counting on your feedback and would greatly appreciate it if you leave it the in-game survey or on Discord in the [url="https://discord.com/channels/996757051399221288/1563197785875157142"]discussion thread[/url].[/p][p align="start"][i]Sincerely,[/i]
[i]EXBO Team[/i][/p]

newsitems.title: Metropolite's arena

newsitems.title: Chain of Decay — Rewards!
newsitems.author: Fitasuon
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41581512/fbaf15e1e3644f9c71cb7db8a56456c357fca0e2.png"][/img]Today, we are rewarding everyone who actively took part in solving the mystery and completing the quest.[/p][p]Initially, we planned to reward only the players who stood out within the community, as well as the first player to complete the quest. However, we have now decided to revise our approach.[/p][quote][p]In addition to the previously mentioned player categories, we have also added a reward for those who helped the first player with the completion, as well as for those who managed to collect all the tapes before [b]04.09.2026, 08:00 AM GMT+3.[/b][/p][/quote][p]Along with this, we have revised the rewards themselves and added a bit more uniqueness to them:[/p][p]1. Reward for collecting the tapes before the quest was completed[/p][quote][p]• Audio Recorder charm;  [/p][p]• “Follower of the Decay” achievement.[/p][/quote][p]2. Reward for active community members[/p][quote][p]• Audio Recorder charm;  [/p][p]• Thirty-Fifth Cockroach charm;  [/p][p]• “Witness of the Decay” achievement.[/p][/quote][p]3. Reward for the trailblazer’s companions[/p][quote][p]• Audio Recorder charm;  [/p][p]• Thirty-Fifth Cockroach charm;  [/p][p]• Fourth Lever decor;  [/p][p]• “Guide of the Decay” achievement.[/p][/quote][p]4. Reward for the trailblazer[/p][quote][p]• Audio Recorder charm;  [/p][p]• Thirty-Fifth Cockroach charm;  [/p][p]• Fourth Lever decor;  [/p][p]• “One Who Knows Decay” achievement;  [/p][p]• Keeper of Truth skin for the Albatross Assault.[/p][/quote][p]Once again, congratulations to everyone involved in solving the mystery, especially the first player to complete the quest and their companions: [b]BAZAROMA, Max_Cota, C_Obakevich, and MrXanter[/b]![/p]
